info.name: Genda Phool E-Commerce API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Genda Phool Backend - 126 endpoints across 19 sections.

Includes: Authentication, User Profile, Address, Products, Cart, Orders, POS, Payments (Razorpay + Wallet), Subscriptions, Support, Notifications, Delivery Partner, Delivery Slots, Discounts, Invoices, Admin & Analytics.

Base URL: http://185.137.122.250:8083/api/v1
Swagger Docs: http://185.137.122.250:8083/api/docs/

request.description: Send OTP via WhatsApp using gp_daily_authcode template message.
DEBUG ONLY: Retrieve OTP from database for testing. Only works when DEBUG=True.
Verify OTP and receive JWT access and refresh tokens.
Get new access token using refresh token.
Get all active sessions for the user.
Update user GPS location and automatically assign nearest store using Haversine formula.
Get list of nearby stores based on user's current location.
Manually switch to a different store.

GET: Retrieve address details.
PUT: Update address (send JSON body).
DELETE: Delete address.
Get all products with optional filters.
Get all reviews for a product.
Submit a review for a product.
Get category details and its products.
Admin: Get inventory details for a product.
Get user's shopping cart with items and totals.
Add product to cart. Multi-store cart prevention enforced.
Get user's orders with optional status filter.
Get order details by order number.
Create Razorpay payment order for checkout.
Verify Razorpay payment signature and confirm order.
Add money to wallet via Razorpay.
Pay for order using wallet balance.
Admin: Assign ticket to support agent.
Admin: View all tickets with filters.
Delivery Partner: Get today's assigned routes.
Get route details with all stops.
Delivery Partner: Mark route as complete.
Delivery Partner: Get today's delivery orders.
Delivery Partner: Mark order as picked up from store.
Delivery Partner: Update delivery status of an order.
Delivery Partner: Get next delivery stop.
Get available delivery slots for a specific store and date.
Admin: Create a new delivery slot for a store.
Admin: Create discount. Levels: product, subcategory, category.
Get all invoices for authenticated user.
Admin: Generate invoice PDF for an order.
Admin: Resend invoice to customer via WhatsApp or Email.
Admin: Get dashboard analytics overview including total orders, revenue, users, and store metrics.
